description: This file contains Kotlin extension functions for the Android View class, providing safe and convenient methods to toggle view visibility between VISIBLE and GONE. It is used within the Android project to simplify visibility management across the UI components.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Extension function for nullable View that sets the visibility to View.VISIBLE if the View is not null.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Extension function for nullable View that sets the visibility to View.GONE if the View is not null.
